items.title: The defining equations of a relative global complete intersection form a Koszul regular sequence
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the equations presenting a relative global complete intersection over a ring form a Koszul regular sequence. The proof uses that the Koszul homology groups are annihilated by the ideal generated by the equations, so it suffices to check that their localisations vanish at every prime containing that ideal; at such a prime the conormal description of the relative global complete intersection identifies the situation with that of a regular sequence, and regularity implies Koszul regularity by the standard comparison.
